title: Reflex tree
description: What an instruction's record looks like (a reflex among them): on its page, how often it was said lately and, run by run, whether the miss it answers came back after it was said there. Reads the record the reflex_said pack keeps; owns no type, so it is a map pack beside reflex, which keeps the words. And the reflex tree: the instructions and reflex nodes as one tree growing from its root, amber where the model writes a node, blue where one is said (after Sihan Xu's essay on a growing behaviour tree).

views.description: An instruction's record as rows: the first its counts lately (said, to how many runs, came back, held, quiet, when last), then each run it was said to, the newest first, with what became of its miss there.

about.description: The instruction whose record is drawn.

views.description: The record of some instructions, for the tree's drawing to ask through its sends: one per id asked, in order, each { id, said, runs, places, last, failed, held, quiet, tier, status, for, per_run: [{ said_at, verdict }] } (the item's status and for as given; the record is the reflex_said pack's said_record). An owner's version of a preset is counted under the preset's id.

ids.description: The instructions (reflexes among them), 50 at most.

views.description: Every miss lately, for the tree's drawing to ask through its sends, the newest first: { kind (refusal, bump, trap), key, run, at, where, said, covered_by } (the reflex_said pack's misses). Params: days (30 unless said, 90 at most), limit (the newest so many).

limit.description: The newest so many, 1000 at most.

views.description: The tree's story over a window, for its drawing to ask through its sends, as one answer (not rows): { from, to, nodes: [{ id, kind (instruction or rule), pack, tier, effect (a rule's), status, for, title }], misses: [{ at, where, kind, grew }], said: [{ id, at, verdict }], fired: [{ id, day, effect (held, refused, asked), n }] }. Nodes are the ids asked, every preset said in the window and every rule in force; a miss is one no settled node covers, grew the trial that covers it. Params: ids (at most 50), days (30 unless said, 90 at most).

ids.description: The nodes in the view, 50 at most.

views.description: Every rule in force, for the tree's drawing to ask through its sends: [{ id, title, pack, effect (hold, refuse, ask, requires...), where (tool:change:<type>:<fields>, reply_ended:<fact>, or the event it is on), fired: [each time it held, refused or asked in the window, as the start of its day] }]. Params: days (30 unless said, 90 at most).

styles.title: Reflex tree
styles.description: The harness's instructions and reflex nodes as one tree, grown from its root: amber where the model writes a node, blue where a node is said on its own.

actions.title: Hide or show on the tree
actions.description: A toggle of the tree's legend, sent by its drawing as the person looking: hides one entry (on false) or shows it again (on true) by the view's style, its hidden list. On a view a pack ships, the first toggle makes the owner's version of it, with the style and query drawn.

view.description: The view the legend is on: a lens's id, or the id of the view a pack ships.

entry.description: kind:rule|instruction, pack:<id>, tier:core|pack|owner|learned, status:trial|current|retired or event:miss|held|failed|fired.

on.description: true shows it, false hides it.

style.description: The style the tree is drawn with: kept in a new version of a shipped view.

filter.description: The view's filter, for a new version.

walk.description: The view's walk, for a new version.

limit.description: The view's limit, for a new version.
